brief: One original diagonal rocket family with four user-selected themes. All four use matching rocket proportions and restrained material glow. Ocean is the package default and fallback. No text or watermark.

variants.design: Purple rocket enlarged to the shared family proportion on pale lavender-white glass, with a coral-orange flame and restrained violet inner bloom
Ocean-blue default rocket with marine-to-cyan depth, reduced sea-glass bloom, warm coral-orange flame and a single clean upper-right rim highlight
Luminous blue rocket on deep obsidian liquid glass with restrained perimeter reflections and reduced flame spill
Graphite rocket on restrained warm-white porcelain glass with reduced corner bloom, subtle cool-gray depth and a warm coral-orange flame
